notablePrerequisites: The amount of life opponents have lost this turn is equal to or greater than Rograkh's commander tax.
description:
Cast Rograkh for {0}.
Cabal Paladin triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Rograkh, to add a mana of any color.
Choose to put Rograkh in the command zone.
Repeat.
